extension_description.message: Switch to recent tabs with a tap. Hold to browse, search, and select tabs in the current window.

controller_window_read_failed.message: Could not get the target window

controller_candidates_updated.message: The candidates changed. Open the list again.

controller_candidate_retry.message: Could not select the tab. Open the list again.

controller_no_tabs.message: There are no tabs to switch to

controller_source_missing.message: Could not identify the source tab

controller_display_source_missing.message: Could not identify the tab for the list

controller_list_cancelled.message: Tab changed. The list could not be displayed.

controller_selection_source_missing.message: Could not identify the selection source tab

picker_controls.message: ↑↓ Select  ·  ← Switch list  ·  Enter Switch  ·  Esc Cancel

picker_unavailable.message: Shortcuts are unavailable in this tab

picker_unavailable_hint.message: You cannot start shortcut-based tab switching after moving to this tab.

picker_no_history.message: No previous tabs. Press ← to view all tabs.

options_intro.message: Move through recently used tabs with Back and Forward shortcuts. Hold the shortcut to choose a tab from a list.

options_shortcuts_description.message: Choose Change or Add, then press the key combination you want to use. You can assign multiple shortcuts to each action. Press Esc to cancel.

options_back_description.message: Go to the previously used tab

options_forward_description.message: Move back toward the starting tab

options_modifier_help.message: Control is the physical Control key (⌃). Meta is the Command key (⌘) on macOS or the Windows key on Windows. Esc, Tab, Enter, and arrow keys are reserved for navigation. Some keys are handled by Chrome or the OS before this extension receives them.

options_legacy_help.message: Assignments from Chrome's shortcut settings are kept separately. The default J/K combinations are the same, and shortcuts configured here are saved in this extension's settings.

options_history_limit.message: MRU tabs to show and keep

options_history_help.message: Keep and show 10–30 past tabs in addition to the current tab. Reducing the limit removes older entries. Increasing it starts retaining additional history from then on. The tab-order list shows all tabs in the current window.

options_skip_unavailable.message: Skip tabs where shortcuts are unavailable when using a short press

options_display_description.message: The extension detects keys on regular web pages and shows tab titles and favicons in the long-press list. Allow access to the sites where you use it.

options_grant_permission.message: Allow key detection and tab lists on web pages

options_page_help.message: Use shortcuts while a regular web page has focus. Chrome internal pages, the Chrome Web Store, and the address bar have input restrictions.

options_usage_short_press.message: Press and release before the hold duration to move one tab Back or Forward. Navigation stops at the ends of the history.

options_usage_hold.message: Hold the modifier keys and the assigned regular key together to show MRU candidates.

options_usage_picker.message: In the list, use Up and Down to select, Enter to switch, and Esc to cancel. Left switches between MRU and tab order. Right has no action.

options_usage_search.message: In tab order, type text to filter tab titles. Press Backspace to delete the last character. Search is case-insensitive and uses tab titles.

options_usage_modifiers.message: Holding only the modifier keys after releasing a regular key such as J or K does not count as a long press.

options_usage_unique.message: Each tab appears once, ordered by recent use.

options_usage_reset.message: Selecting another tab normally ends the current traversal.

options_capture_prompt.message: Press the shortcut for $1. Include Control, Alt, or Meta. Press Esc to cancel.

options_settings_changed.message: The settings changed in another view. Try the action again.

options_duplicate_shortcut.message: This shortcut is already assigned. Choose a different combination.

options_shortcut_required.message: Each action needs at least one shortcut.

options_shortcut_save_error.message: Could not save the shortcut. Try configuring it again.

options_invalid_shortcut.message: Combine Control, Alt, or Meta with a regular key. Esc, Tab, Enter, and arrow keys are reserved.

options_shortcut_ready.message: Use the displayed shortcuts on web pages.

options_settings_load_error.message: Could not load settings. Reload this page.

options_permission_allowed.message: Key detection and tab lists are allowed on web pages.

options_permission_limited.message: Site access is restricted. Allow access to the sites where you want to use key detection and tab lists.

options_permission_error.message: Could not check site access. Reload this page.

options_settings_saved.message: Behavior and history settings saved. Active key gestures and tab lists are cancelled.

options_settings_save_error.message: Could not save settings. Try saving again.

options_permission_denied.message: Site access is pending. Key detection and tab lists become available after access is granted.

options_permission_request_error.message: Could not grant site access. Check site access in Chrome's extension settings.

options_settings_refresh_error.message: Could not refresh settings. Reload this page.
